newsitem.title: CHINA: Kingboard places 66 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Kingboard places 66 mln new shares.

text.p: Kingboard Chemical Holdings Ltd said on Friday it would place 66 million new shares to parent Hallgain Management Ltd at HK$2.40 each after the parent placed out the same amount of shares at the same price.
The shareholding of Hallgain in Kingboard will be diluted to 43.17 percent on completion of the deal on July 26, from 57.17 percent, it said.

The laminates maker said of net proceeds of HK$153 million to be raised from the deal, HK$100 million would be used for acquiring additional manufacturing plant and equipment with the balance of HK$53 million going to working capital.
Kingboard shares fell HK$0.10 to HK$3.30 in mid-morning.
